title: feat(fleet-write): pr_enqueue_front jumps an accepted pull to the front of the merge queue
body:
Fixes #31403

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中继新增 `pr_enqueue_front` 一行，把一个已 ACCEPT 的 PR 插到合并队列最前面；`fleet-write.yml` 只在这一笔里申请 `merge-queues` 写权限；landing-operations.md 加 5 行插队规则 (a)(b)(c)。
- 为什么改：cloud#3686 当天要你手动插队；你在卡上选了 A（评论 6729640900），让席位按 (a)(b)(c) 自己插队。
- 风险与回滚：插队会重排别人已排队的 PR；中继先拒 draft、head 已移、受治理路径、发版 PR、超 3000 行、已有插队者，读回非队首即 FAILED。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` 新增的 `permission-merge-queues` 一行，再看 `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` 的 `pr_enqueue_front` 行和 `ENQUEUE_FRONT_FENCES`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test` 与 `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` 均退出 0。
- 需要你做的：裁定 landing-operations.md 行数上限 102→107（未裁前行数门禁红）；审 workflow 改动（Tier H）并合并。App 的 Merge queues 权限你已加上。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: a new `alone` row `pr_enqueue_front` (`pull`, `expected_head_sha`). It sends `enqueuePullRequest(jump: true, expectedHeadOid)`. Its grant `merge-queues` is stroke-scoped beside `actions` and `repository-advisories`, and it also spends `contents` and `workflows`, like `automerge_enable`. The header section "The one row that reorders the merge queue" documents the fences and the read-back.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`: a preflight reads the pull, its files, the base ref and the base's merge queue. It refuses with zero writes when the pull is not open, is a draft, has moved head, is a Version Packages pull, touches a governed surface, is over `HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD`, or when another entry already jumped. After the mutation it polls the queue. Success means the entry reads `jump: true` with no entry ahead. A `jump: false` entry, or an entry behind another, is FAILED ("do not re-send"). An integration refusal is FAILED and names the missing `Merge queues: write` grant. The queue reads are unpaced (`read: true`).
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`: the row joins every pin. The validator writes `permission_merge_queues=write` for this stroke only and an empty value for every other.
- `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`: `permission-merge-queues: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.permission_merge_queues }}`. Every other stroke's token is unchanged.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md`: five lines saying when a seat may ring the jump: (a), (b), (c), the audit comment first, one jumper per repo, and FAILED handling.
- ⚠️ Not yet in this diff: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` is red at this head. landing-operations.md is 107 lines against its ceiling of 102. Raising the ceiling to 107 as an ordinary ruled raise waits on the maintainer's ruling, and it will be pushed as its own commit once that ruling lands. The PR is opened now so the contract review can run in parallel.

## Why

The relay could enqueue a green pull only at the back of the queue. The maintainer ruled A on #31403 (comment 6729640900): seats may ring the jump on their own call under (a)(b)(c), with the grant minted per stroke. The App grant was added by the maintainer on 2026-11-09. Whether GitHub honours `jump` for an App token is NOT MEASURED until the first live stroke, and that stroke's read-back judges it.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, including the new 20-case `pr_enqueue_front` battery.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, including the new 10-case battery.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 61 derived gates ran. 60 exit 0. The one red is `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (exit 1, landing-operations.md at 107 lines against a ceiling of 102), pending the raise above.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched scripts: exit 0.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
